title: Willie Nelson is fighting data centers near his Texas hometown: 'The last thing we need'
excerpt: Willie Nelson says Texas residents don't need "loud, water thieving, light polluting" data centers in their backyard.
content_html:
By Lauren Edmonds

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Americans opposing AI data center construction can officially count superstar activist Willie Nelson as an ally.

Nelson criticized the hefty facilities in an Instagram post on Tuesday. He said residents in his hometown of Abbott, Texas — like elsewhere in the country — must resist them. Although Virginia is the data center capitol of the US, Texas has become a hot spot due to available land, potential tax breaks, and access to the electricity grid.

"The last thing we need is a loud, water thieving, light polluting, data center anywhere near our town (or any others for that matter)," he said.

Nelson said it's imperative that rural communities in America aren't displaced by data centers, which many of those in the AI industry say are vital to the country's future economic growth.

"The strength of rural America has never come from big industrial footprints. It comes from generations of people, open spaces, local businesses, and a connection to the land," Nelson wrote. "All of America deserves thoughtful stewardship that doesn't steal farmland (where our essential shared-food is grown) and small family farmers' livelihoods, and not data centers that only destroy the environment around them."

Nelson also called on Americans to protect their resources.

"Whoever controls food and water, controls the masses. Let's not allow our own demise or give up control over necessary resources in the US and especially in Abbott," Nelson wrote.

For tech companies like Meta, Anthropic, and OpenAI, AI data centers are essential. The facilities, which can cost billions of dollars and span hundreds of acres, power their AI products. President Donald Trump's administration has broadly supported data center construction by accelerating federal permitting and backing the $500 billion Stargate Project.

However, many Americans — including Nelson — are pushing back.

Critics worry that AI data centers, which are much larger than those that store social media or website data, could worsen the environment, raise utility bills, and reduce their quality of life. Across the country, Americans have staged protests, called out local leaders, and taken legal action to stop data center construction.

Politicians are taking notice. Some lawmakers have imposed restrictions, temporary moratoriums, or outright bans on data center construction. New York became the first state to enact a moratorium on AI data centers earlier this month. Democratic Reps. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Bernie Sanders have called for a nationwide federal moratorium.

Although Nelson is the latest celebrity to lambast data centers, he's not the only one. Country music star Brad Paisley joined Americans in protesting a proposed data center near the Nashville Zoo.

content_html_zh:
作者：Lauren Edmonds 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

反对人工智能数据中心建设的美国人可以正式将超级明星活动家威利·纳尔逊视为盟友。

尼尔森周二在 Instagram 上发帖批评了这些庞大的设施。 他说，他的家乡德克萨斯州阿博特的居民——就像该国其他地方一样——必须抵制他们。 尽管弗吉尼亚州是美国的数据中心首府，但德克萨斯州由于可用土地、潜在的税收减免和电网接入而成为热点。

“我们最不需要的就是在我们城镇（或任何其他城镇）附近建立一个吵闹、偷水、造成光污染的数据中心，”他说。

尼尔森表示，美国的农村社区不能被数据中心取代，许多人工智能行业人士表示，数据中心对美国未来的经济增长至关重要。

“美国农村的力量从来都不是来自于庞大的工业足迹。 它来自几代人、开放空间、当地企业以及与土地的联系，”尼尔森写道。 “全美国都应该得到深思熟虑的管理，不会窃取农田（我们必需的共享食物种植的地方）和小家庭农民的生计，也不会窃取只会破坏周围环境的数据中心。”

纳尔逊还呼吁美国人保护他们的资源。

“谁控制了食物和水，谁就控制了群众。 我们不要让自己灭亡，也不要放弃对美国、尤其是雅培必要资源的控制。”尼尔森写道。

对于 Meta、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 等科技公司来说，人工智能数据中心至关重要。 这些设施耗资数十亿美元，占地数百英亩，为他们的人工智能产品提供动力。 唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府通过加快联邦许可和支持 5000 亿美元的“星门”项目，广泛支持数据中心建设。

然而，包括尼尔森在内的许多美国人正在反击。

批评者担心，人工智能数据中心比存储社交媒体或网站数据的数据中心大得多，可能会使环境恶化、提高水电费并降低他们的生活质量。 在全国范围内，美国人举行了抗议活动，呼吁当地领导人，并采取法律行动来阻止数据中心的建设。

政客们正在注意到这一点。 一些立法者对数据中心建设实施了限制、临时暂停或彻底禁止。 本月早些时候，纽约成为第一个暂停人工智能数据中心的州。 民主党众议员 亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯和伯尼·桑德斯呼吁全国范围内的联邦暂停。

尽管尼尔森是最新一位痛斥数据中心的名人，但他并不是唯一一个。 乡村音乐明星布拉德·佩斯利与美国人一起抗议纳什维尔动物园附近拟议的数据中心。
